observations: 2 seater couch/sofa with light beige upholstery (looks like leather or leatherette).
Photo 0 shows the backrest and seat; no obvious major tears, but the seat area looks slightly dull/marked.
Photo 1 shows the corner/arm and seat; there are visible scuffing/marks on the seat surface and slight wear near seams.
No clear close-up of legs/frame, underside, or any damage to cushions/foam.

claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Photos show a generally intact sofa, but there are visible seat/finish marks and no close-ups to confirm how clean/undamaged it is overall (photo 0, photo 1).

risks.risk: Hidden damage or weak cushioning/foam (photos don’t show how it feels or whether it sags).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the seller pressing/sitting on the seat and showing the cushion rebound from the front and side.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible cushion wear (worst case: not fully firm).

risks.risk: Leather/leatherette cracking, peeling, or deep stains not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the arm edges, seat center, and backrest seams in bright light (no blur).
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worn (worst case: stains/scuffs).

risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the underside/legs and a short clip showing the sofa being lifted slightly and set down to confirm stability.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing minor repair/adjustment (worst case: not perfectly stable).

risks.proof: Ask for measurements: length, seat height, seat depth, and back height.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard 2-seater without premium sizing.

proof_requests: Video: seller sits on it and presses the seat to show cushion rebound (front + side).
Close-up clear shots: arm edges, seat center, backrest seams, and any stitching/creases.
Photo/clip of legs/underside to confirm frame condition and stability.
Measurements: total length, seat height, seat depth, and back height.
response.reason: It appears to be a used 2 seater sofa with visible surface wear/scuffs but no clearly obvious major damage in the photos; a worst-case used pricing against similar 2-seater listings is possible.
